<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1397">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12_md-8">
Beach Bungalow at Wulfener Hals</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_md-8">Your vacation home on Fehmarn, right on the beach</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-8 block">
<p>Do you dream of an idyllic vacation home right on the Baltic Sea, on Fehmarn Beach? Our cozy beach bungalow at Wulfener Hals is located on the steep coastal cliffs and consists of two small rooms, a dining room with a kitchen, a living room, and a bathroom with a shower. In front of the house, there&rsquo;s a terrace and a garden with a lawn for sunbathing, patio furniture, and a beach chair. By the way: As a guest in our vacation homes, you can, of course, take advantage of all the amenities the vacation park has to offer.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article section-primary block" id="article-1398">

<div class="col-12_lg-8 bg-grass grid">
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-8 block">
<h2>Beach Bungalow</h2>
<p><strong>35 m&sup2;, for 2 people</strong></p>
</div>
<div class="ce_hyperlink button button-primary col-12_md-4 block">
<a href="https://www.wulfenerhals.de/ergebnisliste-ferienhaeuser?cbpid=524" class="hyperlink_txt" title="Jetzt Verf&uuml;gbarkeit pr&uuml;fen">Check Availability Now</a>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12 block">
<ul>
<li>Location: Vacation home right on the beach</li>
<li>Size: 35 square meters</li>
<li>Occupancy: two people</li>
<li>Separate kitchen and dining room</li>
<li>Number of living/bedrooms: two</li>
<li>Bathroom with shower</li>
<li>Patio with patio furniture, beach chair</li>
<li>Dishwasher</li>
<li>Stove and Microwave</li>
<li>TV and stereo system</li>
<li>Basic Wi-Fi connection, free of charge</li>
<li>Parking space for a car at the house</li>
<li>Dogs are not allowed</li>
</ul>
</div>
